home.hero_subtitle: Tell us about your situation in your own words. JanSetu finds schemes you may be eligible for and helps you apply seamlessly.
home.voice_first_desc: Speak naturally in your preferred language. We understand the context.
home.smart_matching_desc: Find government schemes relevant to your unique situation automatically.
home.privacy_first_desc: Your government documents are processed securely and are not retained.
home.how_it_works_sub: Four simple steps to access the benefits you deserve.
home.step1_desc: Share your situation using voice or text.
home.step3_desc: Verify your information and prepare your application.
home.step4_desc: Track your application from submission to approval.
home.schemes_simplified_sub: Explore some of the most accessed programs below, or ask JanSetu to find the right one for you.
home.cta_title: Not sure which scheme is right for you?
home.cta_desc: Just tell JanSetu your situation. We'll securely match you with the right programs and guide you through the application.

assistant.step_desc: You can speak or type. No complicated forms.
assistant.bot_greeting: Namaste! Tell me about yourself — your occupation, family situation, income, and location. I'll help find the government schemes you may be eligible for.
assistant.prompt_1: I am a farmer with 2 acres of land
assistant.prompt_2: I am looking for housing assistance
assistant.prompt_3: I am a student from a low-income family
assistant.analyzing: JanSetu is analyzing your details with rules engine...
assistant.understood_desc: We've extracted this information based on your conversation. Please review and confirm these details before we match you with eligible government schemes.
assistant.why_need_desc: Accurate details ensure we only show you schemes where you have a high probability of approval.
assistant.complete_desc: You can continue chatting or review your information.

schemes.title: Schemes you may be eligible for
schemes.subtitle: Based on the information you provided, we found {{count}} relevant schemes.
schemes.explore_desc: Provide more details to uncover additional government schemes you might be eligible for.
schemes.empty: No matching schemes found. Try describing your situation differently.

details.disclaimer_text: The information provided is based on official guidelines but may be subject to change. Please verify with local authorities before making financial decisions. JanSetu AI assists in finding schemes but does not guarantee approval.

apply.prep_desc: We'll use your verified information to pre-fill the form. Review everything carefully before submission.
apply.digilocker_desc: Your documents are processed securely and are not stored by JanSetu.
apply.review_desc: Please verify all details carefully before submitting. Ensuring accuracy helps speed up the processing of your application.
apply.declaration_text: I confirm that the information provided is correct and I consent to the terms of service. I understand that false declarations may result in rejection.

track.docs_verified_note: Aadhaar & Land Records authenticated via DigiLocker
track.under_review_note: Your application is currently being reviewed by the designated nodal officer.
